purpose: Generate a single-image quote card where the typography IS the design. AI generates a complete composition with Arabic and/or English text rendered natively as graphic, not overlaid afterward. Best for inspirational quotes, brand manifestos, founder statements, occasion greetings.

quote_text_en.description: English quote text (optional, paired with Arabic)

tone_descriptor.description: Tone direction: contemplative, bold, warm, dignified, kinetic

prompt_template: A single-image quote card composition. {tone_descriptor} mood. Arabic typography rendered natively (not overlaid): "{quote_text_ar}". Composition: {composition_grammar_from_fingerprint}. Color palette: {primary_palette_from_fingerprint}. Background: {background_treatment}. Typography style: clean, dignified Arabic calligraphy or modern sans depending on register. No watermarks. No generic stock-photo elements. {cultural_constraints_injection}.
anti_patterns: Do not use English-default fallback when Arabic is the primary audience language
Do not render Arabic text as graphic overlay — must be native composition
Avoid Western-style typographic ligatures that don't match Arabic register
Never use this chain for breaking news or time-sensitive announcements (use TF03 instead)
notes: Arabic text validation is critical. fal models can hallucinate Arabic letters. Always run post-generation Arabic spell-check before client delivery.
